title: A pane split by a new pane keeps its old size
body:
Jack reports on 2026-11-06 that a new terminal pane made while a terminal pane is focused gets drawn over by the old terminal. The old terminal keeps its size until something calls `relayout`.

`Layout::add_transient` in `src/panes.rs` splits the focused pane, calls `arrange`, and sets `layout.focused` to the new pane. `new_terminal_pane` in `src/compositor.rs` then calls `focus(id)`, which reads `previous` from `layout.focused`. That is already the new id, so `configure(previous)` and `configure(id)` both target the new pane, which has no client yet. The pane that was split never gets its new size.

The same order appears in `commit`, where an unknown window gets `add_transient` and then `focus`, and in `remove_pane`, where `layout.remove` grows a neighbour and `focus` configures only the focused pane.

## Proposal

All three sites call `relayout()` before `focus`. `relayout` configures every pane with its current rect and Activated state.
